content: Although word expert supervised WSD methods perform better, they are less flexible than knowledge-based methods in the all-words WSD task BIBREF10. Recent neural-based methods are devoted to dealing with this problem. BIBREF11 present a supervised classifier based on Bi-LSTM, which shares parameters among all word types except the last layer. BIBREF10 convert WSD task to a sequence labeling task, thus building a unified model for all polysemous words. However, neither of them can totally beat the best word expert supervised methods.
